# Starlit Abyss

Starlit Abyss applies a retro 1980s sci-fi console aesthetic with selectable neon colour schemes and an optional accent-driven hue. An OLED pure-black mode, inverted table styling and other terminal-inspired visuals are toggled through the Style Settings plugin.

![Starlit Abyss screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpcranford/obsidian-theme-StarlitAbyss/HEAD/img/theme_picker.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Starlit Abyss"
    author: "jpcranford"
    repo:   "jpcranford/obsidian-theme-StarlitAbyss"
    slug:   "starlit-abyss"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/starlit-abyss"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jpcranford/obsidian-theme-StarlitAbyss"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jpcranford/obsidian-theme-StarlitAbyss/HEAD/img/theme_picker.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a retro '80s sci-fi console aesthetic with selectable neon color schemes and an optional accent-driven hue. Enable OLED pure-black mode, inverted table styling, and other terminal-inspired visuals, and use the Style Settings plugin to toggle theme options."
}
```
